text.p: Shares in Malaysian property developer Advance Synergy Bhd and associate company United Merchant Group Bhd (UMG) were suspended on Friday, said an official at the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
The shares were suspended at the companies' request pending an announcement by them, said the official.
Advance Synergy shares closed on Thursday at 3.28 ringgit, and UMG closed at 4.00 ringgit.
A company official at Advance Synergy declined to comment on the nature of the announcement, but said it would probably not be made on Friday.
UMG officials could not be reached for comment.
Advance Synergy owns around 20.24 percent of UMG, which is involved in financial services.
In December, Advance Synergy was rumoured to be looking to acquire a stake in Malaysia's Ban Hin Lee Bank, as part of a possible merger with Hong Leong group. Ban Hin Lee later denied the rumours.
